neighbours.label: operator, bracket or unit symbol right after a quantity or variable in an inline technical expression (pH = 5, 10^N, shape [N, k], kJ mol-1)
fire: The buffer was adjusted until the sample sat at roughly pH = 7 for the assay.
To clear the decimals, the value is multiplied by 10^k before rounding it.
The weights tensor has shape [batch, hidden] and is stored in half precision.
The bond breaks once the input exceeds about 300 kJ mol-1 of energy.
When the gain is set so that g = 0 the amplifier passes no signal at all.
The combined output power lies between P – 3 dB and P in most setups.
Each node with weight w = 1 is treated as active by the scheduler.
The area grows as r^2 while the perimeter only grows linearly.
quiet: The buffer was adjusted until the sample sat at a neutral level for the assay.
To clear the decimals, the value is multiplied by a large power before rounding it.
The weights tensor has two dimensions and is stored in half precision.
The bond breaks once the input exceeds a few hundred units of energy.
When the gain is turned all the way down the amplifier passes no signal at all.
The combined output power lies a little below the single source in most setups.
Each node with a nonzero weight is treated as active by the scheduler.
The area grows with the square of the radius while the perimeter grows linearly.

notes: card: peaks on ' [', ' =', '^', ' –', ' mol' following a variable in prose formulas
